brand_source: data/brand.json (palette_lock=true). Every color and font below is a token from the official kit; nothing outside it is introduced.

reference_method.actual: Pinterest page fetch blocked (HTTP 403). 10 pins were identified through web search and only their text descriptions were read; the images themselves were not opened or downloaded. They were supplemented with 3 public-domain historical manuscript references (Wikimedia Commons, to be license-verified in Phase 5). Only abstract tokens were extracted, with no copying of any design, image, logo or font.

references.subject: Map of the Round City of Baghdad
references.token: Overhead radial geography; the city as a circle cut by the Tigris, rendered as an animated line map

references.subject: Aerial view of a walled medieval city
references.token: High establishing angle with walls and water as the composition's frame

references.subject: Mongol cavalry in a Persian miniature
references.token: Flat perspective, horizontal ranks of horsemen; movement read from repeating forms, not speed

references.subject: Ilkhanid board (miniatures + maps)
references.token: Small-scale architectural framing inside the painting: text above the walls, figures at the gate

references.subject: Map motion graphics for a historical documentary
references.token: Map revealed with route lines drawn progressively + slow camera pan

references.subject: Historical motion graphics
references.token: Pinned photos on an old map — useful for figure cards on the timeline

references.subject: Chiaroscuro / candlelight
references.token: Single warm light source, deep black shadows: suits library and court scenes

references.subject: Gold geometric pattern on black
references.token: Thin gold line geometry over dark ground — used as a very faint background ornament (≤6% opacity)

references.subject: Film grain and dust texture
references.token: Light grain (brand: grain 0.12) instead of heavy scratches

references.subject: Cavalry silhouettes in fog
references.token: Violence implied through silhouettes and dust, no blood or close-up gore

references.subject: Hülegü's army besieging Baghdad — Jamiʿ al-Tawarikh (14th century)
references.token: Real archival imagery in parchment frames; caption: manuscript title + century

references.subject: Maqamat al-Hariri illustrations (al-Wasiti, Baghdad 1237)
references.token: Pre-fall Baghdad life: library, market, mosque — the human scene before the disaster

references.subject: The caliph locked up among his treasures — Livre des merveilles (15th century)
references.token: Shows how Europe imagined the event = a narrative layer, not a document; always labeled

palette.role: Exclusive signal of the 'historical fiction' world: frame + label + ConceptMorph
Source cards, lower-third roles, secondary text

palette_support.gold_light: #C2A469 — highlighted keywords and numbers in captions (per captions.rules)

scale_16x9_1920x1080_derived.note: brand.json defines only the 9:16 scale; these values are derived proportionally and need approval

typography.rtl: direction: rtl; Arabic digits shown as Western Arabic digits (1258) per channel practice; foreign names with partial tashkeel

signature_moves.TimelineBar: Thin gold line along the bottom, drawn right to left (RTL) with gold dots for dates; becomes burgundy once the timeline splits into a fictional branch
signature_moves.ConceptMorph: Real → hypothetical transition: gold frame dissolves into burgundy over 600ms with a crossfade, no spinning or flashing
signature_moves.KeywordPop: One word rises 12px with opacity 0→1, then holds 1s
signature_moves.MapDraw: Route lines drawn progressively at 1.5–2s per segment (Mongolia → Alamut → Hulwan → Baghdad)

layout_rules.logo: Official watermark at top-center, opacity 0.8, 72px, static — never regenerated
layout_rules.fiction_label: From scene 14 (the turning point) to the end of the alternate scenario: a 'خيال تاريخي' label in the top-right corner (outside the logo zone) + a 2px burgundy hairline frame
layout_rules.negative_space: Wide negative space; one main element per frame
layout_rules.captions: 2 lines max, 28 Arabic characters max per line, keywords and numbers in gold_light, never covering faces or source cards
layout_rules.english_text: Not allowed on screen except the end card (brand negative_rules)

texture.ornament: Faint geometric gold pattern (≤6%) only on chapter cards

visual_honesty.archival: Manuscript title + century in the source card
visual_honesty.ai_generated: Persistent small label 'إعادة تصوّر بصري' in the corner + logged in credits.csv
visual_honesty.historical_figures: Artistic representation without a realistic 'photographic face'; manuscript style or silhouette
